5.measure_note: THIS PAGE IS NOT A COUNTY SCHEDULE FORM: it is the candidate's own TYPED LANDSCAPE ledger headed 'Douglas Witney / Campaign Contributions/Expenditures', carrying TWO side-by-side tables (Contributions left with Date/Contributions/Address/Amount, Expenditures right with Date/Expenditures/Amount) and NO printed rules at all — rowbands.py returns 0 h_rules, so the underline convention does not apply. Bands were measured with the ADDENDUM A2 recovery, `rowbands.py 5 --text-lines --col 84,91`, i.e. a dark-run projection restricted to the EXPENDITURE amount column: it returns the header band at 12.06, twenty prior-period data bands 14.00-52.79 at a 2.06 pitch, the printed 'Total Expenditures $2,703.70' band at 58.91, and eight period data bands 67.10-81.40. `rows` holds all 28 DATA bands in printed order (padded 0.30 either side), so a published row's `row` index is its true position in the printed expenditure column; the header and total bands are excluded. THE SHEET CARRIES A +1.1 DEGREE SKEW (2.48% of page height in drift), SO A BAND MEASURED IN ONE COLUMN DOES NOT TRANSFER ACROSS IT — the same physical line sits at 67.10 in the expenditure column and 67.15 in the contribution column. The six CONTRIBUTION rows are therefore carried as explicit per-row `geometry` strings measured in their own column (x 45.0-53.5, from a second --text-lines --col 46,53 pass) and those WIN over this frame. TWO-CROP PROOF at 900 dpi, both tables: expenditure band 21 pct:83.5,66.80,8.5,1.84@p5 rendered '$150.00' (recorded 150.00) and band 28 pct:83.5,81.10,8.5,1.84@p5 rendered '$500.44' (recorded 500.44); contribution band 5 pct:45.00,66.85,8.50,1.84@p5 rendered '$500.00' (recorded 500.00) and band 10 pct:45.00,77.04,8.50,1.89@p5 rendered '$20.00' (recorded 20.00). notes: PAGE-FACE candidate name 'Douglas Witney' (Republican, residence city Springville); index.csv names NO candidate for this row. Page-face Office Seeking reads 'Utah County Commission SEAT B', agreeing with index.csv. THIS FILING IS AN AMENDMENT: the cover ticks 'Seven days preceding the General Election' AND ticks 'Yes' on 'Is this report an amendment?', writing '10-20-2010' on the Date of Report line; it is signed 10-20-2010 and stamped received OCT 25 PM 1:51. It is ONE report, not a multi-report bundle, so no report_index is set. The p2 Summary Page's own top-right Page/Last Name/Date box is left WHOLLY BLANK, and the printed label of line 3 is partly overprinted by the form's 'Refer to Line 7 on your last report' arrow so that only '...orting Period' shows — the line is still line 3 and carries 846.30. A SOURCE PROPERTY THIS BRIEF DID NOT LIST, AND A THIRD VARIANT OF THE ADDENDUM A2 PATTERN: THE COUNTY'S SCHEDULE A (p3) AND SCHEDULE B (p4) ARE BOTH PRESENT, BOTH EMPTY OF ENTRIES, AND BOTH VOIDED BY THE FILER — each carries a single handwritten line on its first ruled row reading 'Refer to attached Spreadsheet' and one large diagonal stroke drawn across the whole grid, with the 'Subtotal for this page' and 'Total ... Received' cells left blank. That is NOT an `empty-schedule` state (the filer did not report zero entries) and NOT `no-schedule-page` (the pages exist): the entries are real and live on the attached ledger, so both sides are `transcribed` and the arithmetic gate is the cover plus the ledger's own printed totals. Compare this filer's MAY report, which had no county schedule pages at all; his OCTOBER report has them and cancels them. THE LEDGER IS CUMULATIVE AND IS RE-PRINTED IN FULL EACH REPORT, divided by the filer's own dated 'Remaining Balance' line, and p6 is a one-line summary sheet restating Period/Total Contributions and Expenditures and the 10/20/2010 remaining balance. WHAT THE AMENDMENT ACTUALLY CHANGED, visible only by comparing the ledger's prior-period block with the May filing: in May the contribution ledger carried TWO typed lines (500.00 + 50.00 = 550.00) plus a HANDWRITTEN 3,000.00 'Personal loan' annotation that the May cover assigned to line 3, Balance at Beginning. In this October reprint that annotation has been TYPED IN and SPLIT INTO TWO ledger lines — '5/1/2010 Loan from Doug Witney $1,000.00' and '5/11/2010 Loan from Doug Witney $2,000.00' — and the block's printed 'Total Contributions' is now $3,550.00: the filer has RECLASSIFIED his own loan from an opening balance into contributions, and Column B here (10,370.00 = 3,550.00 + 6,820.00) carries that forward. Nothing was recomputed or adjudicated; the prior-period rows are not republished (they belong to the May report's own record) and this note exists so the change is not silently lost. Not a *_Redacted.pdf — the county published this era in the clear, so donor street lines are plainly visible on p5 and were reduced to city/state at READ TIME; none reaches any field or note.
